surgeryIndex.description: Aesthetic, intimate and gender-affirming procedures planned around your anatomy, your moment and your goals.
surgeryIndex.procedureText: Every surgery begins with a conversation. The medical assessment considers your history, anatomy, expectations and safety to build a truly individual recommendation.
surgeryIndex.safetyTitle: The right surgery starts with the right indication.
surgeryIndex.safetyText: The decision is built in consultation, with clear information about possibilities, limits, preparation and recovery.
procedureDescriptions: Procedures for increasing penile length and girth, recommended only after individual assessment.
Treatment for excess tissue of the labia and other intimate changes, with technique and discretion.
Gender-affirming surgery with responsible indication and specialized follow-up.
Surgery indicated for transgender men, performed with a bi-incisional technique and areola graft to help manage gender dysphoria.
Aesthetic or reconstructive breast augmentation defined after assessing anatomy and expectations.
Silicone implants placed in the gluteus maximus muscle with individualized indication and technique.
Surgery that reshapes the nasal structure for aesthetic or functional purposes, such as correcting a deviated septum.
Repositioning of muscles and deep facial tissues to reduce sagging, wrinkles and redefine facial contour.
Removal of localized fat to improve body contour in areas such as the abdomen, flanks, back, arms, thighs and double chin.
Surgery that removes excess skin, muscle or fat from the eyelids to rejuvenate the eyes and improve the visual field.
